method.timeAxis: wall seconds since frontend operationsStartedAt, using timezone-bearing ISO timestamps
method.metricTiming: regression/bins use sampling start; metrics are acquired within the retained start/end bracket, not simultaneously
method.post180Selection: all complete sampling intervals within operations with sampling start >=180; boundary exclusions are explicit
method.phasePolicy: all finalized valid checkpoints with independently checked closure; all invalid samples remain in output
method.activeTime: frontend active duration excludes all checkpoint preparation/hold pauses; per-sample active time cannot be reconstructed exactly
method.legacyComparison: separate old driver elapsedSec minus frontend setupSeconds summary, not silently substituted for timestamp alignment

visibility.limitation: Uses existing >5 rAF/s and <=2000ms gap guards; unfocused is not hidden; not a 60fps claim.

limitations: fetch settlement is response headers, not body/callback completion; fallback is not counted
callback observations are snapshots, not continuous pending-request traces; counts include listeners
ID age is an observed lower bound; ID cap/overflow must be considered
ResourceTiming=0 is not proof that WebKit retains no resources; DOM counts are context-dependent

acceptance.reason: Completion, integrity, visibility, full memory trajectories, same-phase evidence and presentation checks require joint review; no slope or endpoint alone assigns pass/fail.
acceptance.scope: No claim about a leak/GC/allocator root cause; regular allocated/networking footprint may be absent by design and are never replaced with zero.
